Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

  • Family-Owned Business — Run by a real dad who gets it
  • Free Shipping on all orders
  • Family Matching Made Easy — Coordinated outfits for photos, holidays, trips, and everyday moments
  • Easy Returns — Clear return and exchange guidance in our refund policy
  • Secure Checkout — Your payment info is always protected

Connect With Us

We love seeing families match! Tag us on social media with #DressLikeMommy and share your moments.

  • Instagram

Have questions? Visit our Contact Us page — we typically respond within one business day.

Vores Historie

Hvor Familie Mode Møder Ægte Forbindelse

Dress Like Mommy blev født ud fra en enkel idé: familier, der matcher sammen, knytter bånd sammen.

Grundlagt i 2016 af Francisco, en far til to piger i Naples, Florida, startede Dress Like Mommy, da han lagde mærke til, hvordan hans døtre lyste op hver gang, de matchede tøj med deres mor. Den glædesgnist — latteren, billederne, de "vi er tvillinger!"-øjeblikke — blev kernen i en virksomhed dedikeret til at bringe familier tættere sammen gennem mode.

Hvad Vi Gør

Vi sammensætter matchende outfits til mødre, fædre og børn — fra hyggelige feriepijamas til hverdags-casual sæt og looks til særlige lejligheder. Hvert stykke er udvalgt med komfort, stil og overkommelighed for øje, så familier overalt kan skabe de perfekte øjeblikke uden at sprænge budgettet.

Vores Kunder

Siden 2016 har vi betjent tusindvis af familier i USA, Canada, Storbritannien og Australien. Uanset om det er julemorgen med matchende nattøj, en familiefotosession eller bare en sjov dag ude med matchende tøj med din mini-me, vender vores kunder tilbage for de smil, disse outfits skaber.

Kvalitet & Omsorg

Hver vare i vores kollektion gennemgår en omhyggelig udvælgelsesproces. Vi samarbejder med pålidelige producenter for at tilbyde de nyeste matchende familiestile til fair priser. Hvis noget ikke er som det skal være med din ordre, står vores kundeserviceteam klar til at hjælpe.

Shipping Policy

Last Updated: January 28, 2026

At Dress Like Mommy, we want your matching outfits to arrive as quickly and safely as possible. Here’s everything you need to know about shipping.

Where We Ship

We currently ship to:

  • United States (all 50 states + territories)
  • Canada
  • United Kingdom
  • Australia

Can’t find your country? Contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com — we may be able to arrange shipping to additional destinations.

Shipping Rates

Free standard shipping on all orders. No minimum purchase required.

Processing Time

Orders are processed within 1–3 business days after payment confirmation. You’ll receive an email with your tracking number once your order ships.

Note: During peak seasons (holidays, special promotions), processing may take an additional 1–2 business days.

Delivery Times

Estimated delivery times after your order has been processed and shipped:

  • United States: 7–15 business days (standard) | 5–7 business days (express, where available)
  • Canada: 10–20 business days
  • United Kingdom: 10–20 business days
  • Australia: 12–25 business days

These are estimates. Actual delivery times may vary due to customs processing, carrier delays, weather, or local conditions.

How Our Shipping Works

We partner with trusted international shipping carriers to deliver your order. Here’s what to expect:

  1. Order Placed — You’ll receive an order confirmation email immediately
  2. Order Processing — We prepare and quality-check your items (1–3 business days)
  3. Shipped — You’ll receive a shipping confirmation with tracking number
  4. In Transit — Track your package using the link in your email
  5. Delivered — Your matching outfits arrive at your door!

Order Tracking

Every order includes a tracking number. Once your order ships, you’ll receive an email with:

  • Your tracking number
  • A direct link to track your package
  • Estimated delivery date

You can also check your order status anytime by visiting our Order Status page.

Customs and Duties (International Orders)

For orders shipped outside the United States, please be aware:

  • Your country may charge import duties, taxes, or customs fees upon delivery
  • These charges are not included in our prices and are the customer’s responsibility
  • We have no control over these charges and cannot predict their amount
  • Contact your local customs office for more information

Shipping Issues

Package not arrived? If your order hasn’t arrived within the estimated timeframe, please:

  1. Check your tracking information for the latest status
  2. Allow 2–3 extra business days (delays happen, especially during busy seasons)
  3. Contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com if your order is significantly delayed

Wrong address? Please double-check your shipping address at checkout. We’re not responsible for orders shipped to incorrect addresses provided by the customer. If you notice an error, contact us immediately — we may be able to update the address before shipping.

Damaged or missing items? Contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos of any damage. We’ll work with you to make it right.

Contact Us

Questions about shipping? We’re here to help:

  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Phone: (786) 309-6006

We typically respond within 24–48 hours.

Shipping policy by Dress Like Mommy, operated by FKG Trading LLC.

Returns & Exchanges

We want you and your family to love your matching outfits! If something isn't right, we're here to help.

Return Window

You have 30 days from the date of delivery to request a return or exchange.

Eligibility

To be eligible for a return, items must be:

  • Unworn, unwashed, and in original condition
  • In their original packaging with all tags attached
  • Free of stains, pet hair, perfume, or signs of wear

Non-Returnable Items

  • Swimwear and intimates (for hygiene reasons)
  • Items marked as "Final Sale"
  • Gift cards
  • Items returned after 30 days

How to Start a Return

  1. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and reason for return
  2. Our team will review your request and respond within 1 business day
  3. We'll provide return instructions and a return shipping address
  4. Ship the item(s) back in their original packaging

Refunds

Once we receive and inspect your return:

  • You'll receive an email confirming we received your item
  • If approved, your refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5–10 business days
  • Depending on your bank, it may take an additional 2–5 business days to appear on your statement

Exchanges

Want a different size or color? Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and we'll help you get the right item.

Damaged or Defective Items

Received a damaged or defective item? Contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos of the issue. We'll send a replacement or issue a full refund — no need to return the damaged item.

Late or Missing Refunds

If you haven't received your refund within 10 business days of our confirmation email:

  1. Check your bank account or credit card statement
  2. Contact your credit card company — processing times vary
  3. Contact your bank — there may be additional processing time
  4. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com and we'll investigate

Shipping Costs

  • Return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility, unless the item arrived damaged or defective
  • Original shipping costs are non-refundable

Questions?

Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com or call (786) 309-6006 (Mon–Fri, 9 AM – 5 PM EST).

Politik for returnering og ordreannullering

Hos Dress Like Mommy er vi engagerede i at sikre din fulde tilfredshed med hvert køb. Gennemgå venligst vores politikker for returnering og ordreannullering nedenfor. Hvis du har spørgsmål eller har brug for yderligere hjælp, er du velkommen til at kontakte os på info@dresslikemommy.com.

1. Returneringer

Berettigelse til returnering

  • Tidsramme: Returneringer accepteres inden for 30 dage fra købsdatoen.
  • Stand: Varer skal returneres i original stand, ubrugt, uvasket og med alle mærker intakte.
  • Emballage: Original emballage skal være intakt, og alt originalt indhold skal være med.

Ikke-berettigede returneringer

  • Varer, der er beskadigede, brugte, ændrede eller mangler dele.
  • Returneringer uden den oprindelige bestillingsinformation i pakken.

Returneringsforsendelse

  • Ansvar: Købere er ansvarlige for alle omkostninger ved returnering.
  • Anbefaling: Brug en sikker eller sporbar forsendelsesmetode og behold dit forsendelsesbevis.

Refusioner

  • Fuld refusion: Udbetales for varer returneret i original stand og emballage.
  • Delvise refusioner: Kan fratrækkes, hvis varer returneres beskadigede, brugte eller ufuldstændige for at dække eventuelt værdifald.
  • Behandlingstid: Refusioner behandles typisk inden for 4-6 uger efter modtagelse af den returnerede pakke. Ofte behandles refusioner hurtigere.
  • Verifikation: Refusioner udbetales først, når vi har modtaget de returnerede varer eller gyldig forsendelsesbevis (f.eks. scannet kvittering med dato, tid og sporingsnummer).

2. Ordreannullering

Annulleringspolitik

  • Berettigelse: Ordrer kan annulleres inden for 12 arbejds timer efter betaling.
  • Fremgangsmåde: For at annullere en ordre, kontakt os venligst straks på info@dresslikemommy.com inden for den angivne tidsramme.
  • Efter afsendelse: Når ordren er pakket og afsendt, er det ikke længere muligt at annullere.

3. Hvordan returnerer eller bytter man en vare

Returneringsproces for uegnede eller uønskede varer

  1. Kontakt os: Send en e-mail til info@dresslikemommy.com for at starte din returnering inden for 30 dage efter købet.
  2. Forbered pakken: Pak varen om i dens originale emballage, og sørg for at alle mærkater og tags er fastgjort.
  3. Send varen: Send pakken til den angivne returadresse med en sikker eller sporbar forsendelsesmetode. Vi anbefaler at bruge det lokale postkontor for at minimere omkostninger. Gem dit forsendelsesbevis.
  4. Bekræftelse: Når vi modtager din returnering, behandler vi din refundering eller ombytning og underretter dig via e-mail.

Ombytningspolitik

  • Berettigede ombytninger: Kun størrelser og farver af samme vare kan byttes.
  • Forskellige modeller: For at bytte til en anden model, returner venligst den oprindelige vare og læg en ny ordre på det ønskede produkt.

4. Returnering af fejlbehæftede varer

Hvis du modtager en fejlbehæftet vare, bedes du følge disse trin:

  1. Kontakt support: Send en e-mail til info@dresslikemommy.com med følgende oplysninger:
    • Ordrenummer
    • Dit navn og adresse
    • Detaljer om produktet (antal, SKU)
    • Beskrivelse af problemet
  2. Vedhæft bevis: Inkluder et klart billede af den fejlbehæftede vare i din e-mail.
  3. Returneringsinstruktioner: Vores supportteam vil give dig instruktioner om, hvordan du returnerer den fejlbehæftede vare for at få refusion eller ombytning.

5. Yderligere information

  • Behandling inkluderer: Refunderingsperioden inkluderer transporttid, behandling af returnering og behandling af refundering.
  • Kontakt os: For spørgsmål eller hjælp med returneringer og aflysninger, kontakt os venligst på info@dresslikemommy.com.

6. Ikke-returnerbare varer

  • Personlige eller tilpassede produkter
  • Intimt undertøj
  • Gavekort

7. Kundens rettigheder

Hvis du er bosiddende i Den Europæiske Union, har du ret til at returnere dit køb inden for 14 dage uden at angive nogen grund. For mere information, kontakt venligst vores supportteam.

Is this site secure to use?

It sure is. We use PayPal to process payments, so not even our staff is able to see your payment details. PayPal is the world's largest and most popular secure payment provider when it comes to transactions. For added security, our website is built on the Shopify secure platform. All of your personal information is locked down tight.

What type of payments do you accept?

We accept PayPal and credit/debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover).


I want to pay with my credit card, so why do I get redirected to PayPal page?

We use PayPal to process all our payments. On the right side of the PayPal page, you can select from two options: "Pay with my PayPal account" or "Pay with my credit or debit card".

Do you accept cash on delivery (COD)?

We don’t accept the service for cash on delivery (COD).

Viewing prices in different currencies

You can choose to view prices in different currencies using the drop-down Reference Currency menu at the top of the right of the page. 

Please note that all price of items shown on the site will be changed to the one that the corresponding currency is selected.

We process all orders in USD. While the content of your cart may be displayed in other currency, you will checkout using USD at the most current exchange rate.

My country isn't available in Paypal

Normally you can register free for an account at www.paypal.com - but please note paying by PayPal is only possible in the countries listed on the following web page: http://www.paypal.com/lt/webapps/mpp/country-worldwide

If you have a PayPal account, but you are having problems with sending money or logging into PayPal, please contact PayPal customer service.

About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Our main operations are carried in European Union accomponied by our Support Centre in Lithuania and Manufacturers and Warehouses in East Asia.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We cut out all the middle men and deliver the products directly to consumers from our manufacturers which allows us to offer extremely low prices.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept PayPal and credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover).

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

We use PayPal to process all our payments. In the PayPal page on the right you can select from two options: "Pay with my PayPal account" or "Pay with my credit or debit card"

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

We offer free standard shipping on all orders to the destinations listed in our shipping policy.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We currently ship to the countries listed in our shipping policy. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order is being processed and the order's tracking number is pending. We usually fulfil the orders and send our customers the tracking number when the order's tracking number is submitted to the Postal System, which takes 5-7 days after the order is already shipped.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: support@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

We provide the order's tracking code 5-7 days after you place an order. You can track your order here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Sometimes the first tracking results appear 5-10 business days after you receive the order's tracking number. If the problem remains for more than 10 business days, please contact us: support@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: support@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

We use After Ship tracking system to track our customers orders, so whenever the tracking information is updated, you should receive an email.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing support@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing support@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing support@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact support@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at support@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Om os

A. Generelle spørgsmål

1. Er denne side sikker at bruge?

Det er det bestemt. Vi bruger PayPal til at behandle betalinger. Så ikke engang vores personale får adgang til dine betalingsoplysninger. PayPal er verdens største sikre betalingsudbyder. Vores hjemmeside er bygget på Shopify’s sikre platform. Alle dine personlige oplysninger er godt beskyttet.

 

2. Hvor hurtigt svarer I på e-mail henvendelser?

Vi svarer på alle e-mails inden for en arbejdsdag.

 

3. Hvor er I baseret?

Vores hovedaktiviteter foregår i Den Europæiske Union ledsaget af vores supportcenter i Litauen samt producenter og lagre i Østasien.

 

4. Hvorfor er I så billige?

Vi fjerner alle mellemled og leverer produkterne direkte til forbrugerne fra vores producenter, hvilket gør det muligt for os at tilbyde ekstremt lave priser.

Før du afgiver en ordre

A. Størrelser

1. Hvor kan jeg finde størrelsestabellen i centimeter?

Brug størrelsesguiden for det konkrete produkt og den størrelse, du overvejer. Kontrollér enhederne, og om tabellen viser kropsmål eller tøjets mål. Vores guide til størrelser forklarer, hvordan du måler og sammenligner størrelser. Kontakt os inden bestilling, hvis en tabel eller et mål er uklart.

 

2. Vil jeg modtage en vare to størrelser større?

Størrelsesbetegnelser og mål varierer efter produkt og producent. Vælg hvert stykke tøj ud fra produktets egen størrelsestabel og de tilgængelige valgmuligheder i stedet for at gå ud fra din sædvanlige bogstavstørrelse eller bruge en fast størrelsesomregning. Kontakt os inden bestilling, hvis du er i tvivl.

B. Betalinger

1. Hvilke betalingsmetoder accepterer I?

Vi accepterer PayPal og kredit-/betalingskort (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover).

 

2. Jeg vil betale med mit kreditkort, men bliver omdirigeret til PayPal-siden?

Vi bruger PayPal til at behandle alle vores betalinger. På PayPal-siden til højre kan du vælge mellem to muligheder: "Betal med min PayPal-konto" eller "Betal med mit kredit- eller betalingskort"

C. Forsendelse

1. Hvad er forsendelsesprisen?

Vi tilbyder helt GRATIS levering verden over.

 

2. Leverer I til mit land?

Ja, det gør vi. Vi leverer til alle lande i hele verden.

 

3. Hvor lang tid tager det at modtage min ordre?

Leveringen tager normalt omkring 15-30 dage. Du kan dog tjekke de præcise leveringsestimater her: Forsendelsesside

 

4. Skal jeg betale told?

Nej, du behøver ikke betale toldafgift. Vi markerer alle vores ordrer som lavværdi-gaver. Desuden sender vi større ordrer i separate pakker.

Efter du har afgivet en ordre

A. Ordrestatus

1. Hvad betyder det: ordrestatus "Ikke opfyldt"?

Din ordre behandles, og ordrenummerets sporingsnummer afventer. Vi opfylder normalt ordrerne og sender vores kunder sporingsnummeret, når ordren er indsendt til postvæsenet, hvilket tager 5-7 dage efter ordren allerede er afsendt.

 

2. Hvad betyder det: ordrestatus "Fuldført"?

Det betyder, at din ordre er under forsendelse.

 

3. Det er gået for lang tid, hvor er min ordre?

Tjek venligst din ordres sporingsinformation for mere info. Hvis problemet fortsætter, send os en e-mail: support@dresslikemommy.com

B. Ordresporing

1. Hvordan sporer jeg min ordre?

Vi giver sporingskoden 5-7 dage efter, du har afgivet en ordre. Du kan spore din ordre her: Spor din ordre

 

2. Min sporingskode siger "afventer" eller "ingen information tilgængelig i øjeblikket".

Nogle gange vises de første sporingsresultater 5-10 hverdage efter, du modtager ordrenummeret til sporing. Hvis problemet varer mere end 10 hverdage, kontakt os venligst: support@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. Min sporingskode siger "udløbet"

Kontakt os venligst: support@dresslikemommy.com og vi vil hurtigt løse problemet.

 

4. Hvordan holder jeg mig opdateret om min ordre?

Vi bruger After Ship tracking-system til at følge vores kunders ordrer, så når sporingsinformationen opdateres, vil du modtage en e-mail.

1. Jeg bestilte noget, men vil annullere

Du skal kontakte os inden for 1 hverdag efter bestillingen for at arrangere en ændring af ordren. Det kan du gøre ved at sende en e-mail til support@dresslikemommy.com med dit ordrenummer som emne.

Du skal kontakte os inden for 1 hverdag efter bestillingen for at arrangere en ændring af ordren. Det kan du gøre ved at sende en e-mail til support@dresslikemommy.com med din nye farve- eller størrelsesmulighed.

Your purchase transaction data is stored only as long as is necessary to complete your purchase transaction. After that is complete, your purchase transaction information is deleted.

All direct payment gateways adhere to the standards set by PCI-DSS as managed by the PCI Security Standards Council, which is a joint effort of brands like Visa, MasterCard, American Express and Discover.

PCI-DSS requirements help ensure the secure handling of credit card information by our store and its service providers.

For more insight, you may also want to read Shopify’s Terms of Service here or Privacy Statement.

SECTION 6 - THIRD-PARTY SERVICES

In general, the third-party providers used by us will only collect, use and disclose your information to the extent necessary to allow them to perform the services they provide to us.

Once you leave our store’s website or are redirected to a third-party website or application, you are no longer governed by this Privacy Policy or our website’s Terms of Service.
Links

When you click on links on our store, they may direct you away from our site. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of other sites and encourage you to read their privacy statements.

SECTION 7 - SECURITY

To protect your personal information, we take reasonable precautions and follow industry best practices to make sure it is not inappropriately lost, misused, accessed, disclosed, altered or destroyed.
If you provide us with your credit card information, the information is encrypted using secure socket layer technology (SSL) and stored with a AES-256 encryption. Although no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, we follow all PCI-DSS requirements and implement additional generally accepted industry standards.

By using this site, you represent that you are at least the age of majority in your state or province of residence, or that you are the age of majority in your state or province of residence and you have given us your consent to allow any of your minor dependents to use this site.

If our store is acquired or merged with another company, your information may be transferred to the new owners so that we may continue to sell products to you.

QUESTIONS AND CONTACT INFORMATION

Shipping Information

At Dress Like Mommy, we are an online store that ships matching family outfits to destinations available at checkout through our shipping and fulfillment partners. Here is how to confirm shipping, delivery timing, and tracking before you place an order.

Standard And Express Shipping Options

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

Where We Ship

Shipping availability is based on the country/region and address entered at checkout. If checkout shows a shipping method for your address, we can ship there under the displayed method and rate.

If your destination does not appear at checkout, or if no shipping method is shown, email us at info@dresslikemommy.com before ordering.

Processing And Delivery Times

Orders are processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. During holidays, promotions, or high-volume periods, processing may take an additional 1-2 business days.

Delivery estimates vary by destination, carrier, customs processing, and the shipping method shown at checkout. Review the shipping method and estimate shown during checkout before placing your order.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued.

Order Tracking

Once your order ships, check your email for tracking information. You can also visit your account or use the tracking link in the shipping confirmation email when available.

Customs, Duties, And Import Taxes

For orders outside the United States, your destination country or carrier may collect import duties, taxes, brokerage fees, or customs charges. These are the customer's responsibility unless checkout explicitly says they are included.

We cannot predict these charges, mark orders as gifts, or lower the declared value of an order. Contact your local customs office for destination-specific guidance before ordering.

Shipping FAQ

Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
Contact us as soon as possible at info@dresslikemommy.com. If your order has not moved into fulfillment yet, we can review whether an address change is still possible.

Do you ship to P.O. Boxes?
Shipping availability for P.O. Boxes depends on the destination and carrier options shown at checkout.

My package has not arrived yet.
Check your tracking link first. If the tracking has not updated for several business days or the delivery estimate has passed, email us with your order number.
